rows.en: Miyasco: "...Major Rest somehow managed to smooth things over,
but what were you thinking, doing that as soon as you got back?!"
Touya: "..."
Miyasco: "You were told not to attack
the Zigrim army...
Really, under normal circumstances..."
Sisk: "Now, now. Everything worked out safely,
so isn't it all right?"
Arthur: "Yes. It certainly isn't something to praise him for,
but..."
Clovis: "It's over and done with."
Miyasco: "It is not all right! Major Rest went out of his way
to bow his head when he had no reason to!"
Sisk: "That's true, but...
What's wrong? You're acting a little strange today, Miyasco."
Xiujian: "Why are you getting so worked up?"
Arthur: "Even Fain is calmer than you are."
Fain: "I'm not calm. Getting angry would be a waste of time."
Touya: "..."
Sisk: "See? Everyone thinks you're acting strange."
Miyasco: "Th-that's not true..."
Sisk: "No, you definitely are."
Miyasco: "I-it's nothing!
Anyway, don't do anything like that again!"
Touya: "O-oh..."
Yamato: "Oh dear, you got told off. Well, you brought it on yourself."
Touya: "..."
Sisk: "...Well, anyway, I'm glad everyone's safe.
And Touya managed to rejoin us too."
Clovis: "Yeah. But while we were fighting those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards,
things really went to hell."
Ai: "Exactly! What's going on here?"
Arthur: "Major Rest, General Growster and the others
will be here shortly. We should find out then."
Touya: "Huh? None of you know either?"
Xiujian: "We joined Major Rest and his men
as reinforcements while they were fighting.
Until then, we'd been repairing Liebhofen."
Yamato: "Hey, where's Ymir?"
Sisk: "Not yet..."
Yamato: "Huh? But what about the transmitter?"
Celica: "I've been checking it, but it seems
to be broken. I've got a spare for this part in my room
in the capital, but..."
Touya: "So we have no leads..."
Arthur: "You don't know either, Touya...?"
Touya: "No. We'd been unconscious out there
for two days. And I alone had this strange dream..."
Arthur: "A dream?"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Arthur: "...I see. It's hard to believe at first,
but that would make everything fit.
Everything that's happened, which coincidence alone can't explain."
Xiujian: "Not 109 years ago, but only within the last three years,
our existence, yours and ours, became unstable,
and we came to this world.
Every one of us had high Prana and
a talent for combat. Rayblade, which no one could operate,
accepted you, Touya.
...Yes, that can't be dismissed as coincidence."
Ai: "Hey, is it true that Wenimas
was Ymir's mother?"
Touya: "If I wasn't hallucinating.
And there'd be no point in telling a lie like that."
Arthur: "Now that I think about it, when Ymir
and Bernst first met, his behavior
was strange too.
Even he didn't seem able to hide his surprise."
Celica: "Come to think of it, you're right.
He covered it up by talking about 'the young and beautiful captain.'"
Sisk: "Ymir took it seriously and blushed, though."
Ai: "Well, that's just like Ymir."
Xiujian: "It's an extraordinary story, though.
Unlike the others, this Wenimas
had abandoned her body and become something like a god."
Ai: "Then Ymir is with her father
right now?"
Touya: "Well, that's what it amounts to..."
Sisk: "Oh, a call... No, it looks like a text transmission.
Um, they've arrived, so let them in, it says..."
Derock: "An old-fashioned method and an overbearing message.
We should just ignore it."
Bart: "...We can't very well do that.
They might break through the outer wall to get in.
Think about the time and expense of replacing damaged materials
before you say that."
Celica: "Anyway, let's let them in.
Captain, is that all right?"
Captain Roa: "Yes."
Celica: "..."
Captain Roa: "...?"
Celica: "...I suppose that means he approved.
W-well, we can't do this here,
so let's go to the operations room..."
Growster: "Excuse me."
Yamato: "Oh..."
Touya: "...Well, well."
Growster: "What?"
Ai: "I'd pictured someone much bigger..."
Aurelie: "He's kind of cute."
Growster: "What! I-I'm leaving!"
Fores: "G-General!"
Growster: "Argh, out of my way!"
Miyasco: "Oh, I-I'm terribly sorry.
Honestly, all of you!"
Touya: "Well, sorry, sorry."
Ai: "Right. We didn't mean anything by it, so forgive us."
Aurelie: "You'll never grow big if you get hung up on little things."
Growster: "!!!!"
Miyasco: "...Sigh..."
Reamond: 'Please calm down.
They simply don't understand your greatness, General.
If you lose your temper here,
they'll begin to question your generosity of spirit too.
Getting angry with people who judge only by appearances
will do you no good.'
Growster: "Hmm, that's true.
Hmph! I'll let it pass this time."
Reamond: "Yes... Just as I'd expect of you, General.
You're made of greater stuff than ordinary men."
Growster: "Naturally! Gahahaha!"
Reamond: (...Whew.)
Ai: "...Joking aside, isn't this quite a change of heart,
wanting to talk with us?"
Growster: "Hmph. I'd rather settle things head-on myself!
But I understand that now is not the time for fighting.
If you want a fight, though, I'll accept the challenge."
Ai: "...We aren't looking for a fight."
Growster: "Good. Now that York has become independent too,
I've considered what we should do."
Touya: "Independent...? Don't you mean liberated?"
Growster: "No. Independent.
It was part of Zigrim's territory, however briefly."
Touya: "Right, it was.
Because of your war of aggression."
Celica: "Hey, Touya..."
Growster: "Hmph! There's a spirited one
among you, I see.
As you say, that was indeed
a pointless war of aggression."
Touya: "You talk like it had nothing to do with you.
Aren't you the military's leader?"
Growster: "Are you mistaking Zigrim
for a military dictatorship? That was an official national strategy
approved by parliament. Proposed by that useless fool."
Ai: "So you're saying it had nothing to do with you?!
If you hadn't invaded, Alforina
wouldn't have been killed!!"
Growster: "Yes, that was an unfortunate incident.
But I'm a soldier. I have a duty
to follow my country's decisions. And if I do something, I give it my all,
even if I don't like it."
Ai: "Unfortunate?! Don't brush it off with a word like that!
What you did took the life
of a fourteen-year-old girl!"
Fores: "I was the one directly commanding that battle.
If you want to blame someone, blame me..."
Ai: "That's not what I'm talking about...
Even if you apologize to me, Alforina... She..."
Xiujian: "Ai... They didn't invade because they enjoyed it.
The fact that they're willing to speak like this proves that.
I understand how you feel, but it was war."
Ai: "I know that... But..."
Reamond: "...Then what do you want to do?"
Ai: "...Huh?"
Reamond: "Would it satisfy you if we bowed our heads and apologized?
It wouldn't, would it?"
Ai: "I... I don't know!"
Reamond: "Then come back to us
once you've found out. We'll listen then.
But right now, stopping that insane plan
is our first priority. We want your help with that.
If it's fully put into practice, war will turn into mere slaughter.
Even the guilt soldiers ought to bear will be gone.
War stripped of humanity is a tragedy."
Touya: "That sounds like you're saying war with humanity is fine,
but you're right, we don't have time for that argument now.
If we don't deal with this, we'll destroy ourselves before ≪Ze=Ode≫
even gets a chance to do anything."
Ai: "...All right.
But I'll never forgive you."
Reamond: "Yes. I'm sorry."
Ai: "Hmph! ...So, what do we do?"
Celica: "That's the problem. Normally, Agarthia
should be cooperating to deal with this...
but we're in no position to do that either."
Growster: "...So it really does seem
that a coup has taken place."
Rest: "Yes. I didn't want to believe it,
but the capital is now controlled by a new government
with Prince Tix at its head.
Colonel Geel is said to hold the real power,
but from the soldiers' strange behavior in the last battle,
we can infer that Prince Cain has been working behind the scenes."
Celica: "Major, what happened to my brother?"
Growster: "Hmm. If the coup is real,
he can hardly have escaped this situation unscathed.
He's been captured, or..."
Celica: "No..."
Sisk: "That's not true!"
Growster: "Wh-what?"
Sisk: "His Highness is safe! I know it.
Don't say such ill-omened things!!"
Growster: "I was merely stating
a reasonable assumption..."
Sisk: "...Don't say it."
Growster: "H-hmm... A-all right.
At worst, he's probably just been captured..."
Sisk: "...I'm glad you understand."
Growster: '...Who is that girl?'
Rest: 'I'm sorry. There was a great deal in the past,
and when it comes to Prince Lodis, she's a little...'
Growster: 'I see. So that's a subject best left alone?'
Rest: 'Yes...'
Touya: "I think Lodis is safe too."
Sisk: "Right?"
Touya: "In that last battle, Cain said
he'd soon be finished making Lodis pay.
You can't make a dead man pay.
It's all right. Lodis is alive."
Arthur: "His Highness is alive.
If he'd been killed, there would have been
an announcement about executing him as a traitor or the like.
The fact that there hasn't been one means
we can safely assume he's still all right."
Growster: "Still, for a coup to succeed
so easily...
I suppose this is all Agarthia amounts to."
Fores: "G-General!"
Celica: "...No.
There was certainly a great deal of corruption within Agarthia.
I can't blame him for thinking that."
Rest: "...According to our investigation, the coup forces
claim to be rebuilding that corrupt country,
and assert that Prince Lodis has no legitimate
right to the throne. They put forward Prince Tix
as the rightful heir who will rebuild the kingdom."
Growster: "Straight out of the textbook.
But does Lodis really have no right to succeed?"
Rest: "Impossible. It's their fabrication..."
Celica: "...No. That much is true."
Sisk: "What?!"
Celica: "Yes, we were both born to Mother.
But before she married Father,
she was already carrying my brother.
Because Mother was a 'child of power'..."
Touya: "A 'child of power'?"
Celica: "Someone born with high Prana
and the gift of hearing the Guardian's voice.
I don't know why, but they're born only to the royal bloodline.
Tradition says that if someone with that power takes the throne,
the kingdom will prosper. And in fact, it has."
Celica: "Mother was a distant relative of the royal family, but she'd been raised freely.
She had fallen in love with a knight serving her at the time.
But for the sake of the country, the senior ministers of that time
forced her to marry Father,
who was then the crown prince..."
Growster: "I see. Just the sort of idea you'd expect
from people obsessed with status and tradition."
Celica: "But Father knew everything, and still
he loved Mother...
As she lay dying, she told my brother and me that,
and smiled as she said she'd been happy.
So even after I learned the truth, I was happy
for things to stay as they were. My brother
was still my brother."
Touya: "I see..."
Clovis: "Then what they're claiming
is true..."
Fores: "And it seems they're using the results of a certain project
our president restarted."
Rest: "D-don't tell me..."
Growster: "'Code 3.'"
Rest: "I thought so..."
Fain: "Master, do you know about it?"
Rest: "...'Code 3' was supposed to have been
scrapped by the previous president. If it's been restarted,
does that mean this is the current president's personal agenda?"
Growster: "Most likely. But you seem
to know a great deal about it."
Rest: "I've fought 'Code 3' test subjects
before..."
Growster: "I see. Now I remember.
So that was you..."
Fain: "U-um... Master?
If you could explain..."
Rest: "I was assigned to border patrol at the time.
There, I fought an Armored Mech piloted by a test subject.
Then I made a bargain with Zigrim,
and agreed to pretend I'd seen nothing."
Touya: "A bargain?"
Rest: "A certain woman's future."
Miyasco: "..."
Sisk: "A certain woman...?"
Rest: "No, that's..."
Miyasco: "...It was me."
Celica: "What?!"
Rest: "Miyasco..."
Miyasco: "I'm sorry I kept quiet.
I was one of those test subjects."
Reamond: "And so was I."
Touya: "Hey, now..."
Miyasco: "...The human enhancement project, commonly known as 'Code 3.'
Humans created through genetic manipulation were further
artificially enhanced with drugs,
in a project to create perfect soldiers.
I too was born and raised in the research facility..."
Sisk: "Miyasco..."
Reamond: "That inhumane project, which ignored all ethics,
was immediately halted
and scrapped by the previous president.
The direct cause was that the test subjects went out of control.
Just five of them wiped out two battalions.
But every record of these events was erased in the utmost secrecy,
and buried in the shadows of history."
Miyasco: "That was the incident Major Rest encountered,
and I was one of those five.
Through Major Rest's kindness, I was taken in
by the Kingdom of Agarthia, and eventually
became able to live an ordinary life."
Reamond: "The military moved to shut the project down soon after.
Nearly a hundred test subjects sleeping in capsules
were all killed, and the facility was destroyed.
I was a test subject used to see how far strength could be enhanced
while retaining one's individuality. I wasn't at the facility
at the time, which is why I survived...
This time, rather than creating people from scratch as they did with us,
they seem to be using drugs to make people obey temporarily.
That's the method I believe they're using."
Miyasco: "We have to stop that project
from being put into action, no matter what..."
Rest: "Miyasco..."
Miyasco: "It's all right.
...I'm sorry I kept quiet all this time."
Sisk: "...I see... Now I understand
why you were acting strange."
Miyasco: "...I'm sorry, Sisk."
Sisk: "It's all right. However you came
into this world, you're still Miyasco.
We're still friends."
Miyasco: "Sisk..."
Sisk: "I told you, didn't I?
'True friends never betray each other.'"
Miyasco: "Sisk... Thank you..."
Celica: "Major Rest's decision wasn't wrong.
If the truth about Miyasco had come out then,
people within Agarthia itself would surely have tried
to use her."
Rest: "...I'm sorry."
Growster: "After hearing that account from Reamond,
I was gathering information too.
Honestly, it's just the sort of idiotic idea that useless fool would have.
He regards every living thing except himself
as a fool.
And he'll use any means to achieve his goals."
Touya: "Then how did a bastard like that become president?"
Growster: "Winning popularity and internal maneuvering, including bribery,
are his specialties. And he's cautious.
He never acts openly. I have no proof of what I know.
But I doubt he accounted for the fact
that Reamond was on our side this time."
Reamond: "It took a great deal of effort to keep this hidden until now.
Unfortunately, it's grown beyond anything
I could handle alone... I'm thoroughly ashamed of my inadequacy.
But first, we must deal with
the immediate problem. After Prince Cain's report,
President Horem will probably try to accelerate his plans."
Growster: "Don't tell me he's going to do that
to every soldier back home?"
Reamond: "...Most likely. And Cain
will continue further experiments on the Agarthian army.
If we wait, we won't be able to intervene.
We still have time now. Fortunately, the president seems
to be at his official residence, which is away from the city."
Fores: "An assault on the president's residence...
If this goes badly, we'll be traitors."
Rest: "And this is no longer a question
of Agarthia versus Zigrim. We must worry about ≪Ze=Ode≫ too,
but this is more urgent.
If that project goes into full operation,
we'll be drawn into a futile war of attrition."
Reamond: "Major Rest is right.
If the project goes into operation, Zigrim will unify the continent...
No, the world.
But all that will remain are fields burned by war
and people's profound sorrow.
Would such a victory really mean anything?"
Fores: "Reamond! How can you say that to the General..."
Growster: "...No, it's all right.
Such a victory would indeed mean nothing.
Even if we ruled for a while, it wouldn't last long.
And we can't leave Cain in the Agarthian capital
unchecked either. Even if we secure the president first,
who knows what he'll do next?
We should attack both targets simultaneously."
Rest: "...There's no other way.
It means making the mistake of dividing our forces,
but we have no choice."
Growster: "Then we have a temporary ceasefire."
Rest: "Yes. I pray that it will cease
to be temporary."
Celica: "Then let's discuss
our next operation..."
Rest: "...How does that arrangement sound?"
Growster: "The time needed to get back to the residence was a problem for us.
If you'll transport us on Liebhofen,
we'd be most grateful."
Celica: "...Then Clovis, Xiujian, Ai,
Aurelie and Kururu will go with General Growster's group
to Zigrim aboard Liebhofen."
Celica: "Arthur, Fain, Kasumi, Melissa
and I will go with Major Rest
to the royal capital, Shangria."
Melissa: "Huh? I'm..."
Celica: "Would you rather stay together after all?"
Xiujian: "No, it's fine."
Melissa: "Xiujian?!"
Xiujian: "This is a mission. We shouldn't bring personal feelings into it."
Melissa: "...I might go missing again, you know?"
Xiujian: "Then I'll come and save you,
even at the cost of my life."
Melissa: "Xiujian... All right.
But don't cheat on me, okay?"
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Celica: "Arthur, Fain, Kasumi and I
will go with Major Rest
to the royal capital, Shangria."
Clovis: "...So we're assaulting the president's residence,
taking him into custody and shutting down the project?"
Arthur: "And we're marching on the royal capital.
We'll create a diversion, stop Prince Cain's activities
and rescue His Majesty and His Highness..."
Celica: "That's right. As for you, Touya,
I'd like you to join the capital infiltration team if possible,
but I'll leave the decision to you."
Touya: "Yeah. Let's see..."
Join the presidential residence assault team
Join the capital infiltration team
Check the members
Celica: "...All right. Then you and Yamato
will stay aboard Liebhofen and head for Zigrim's capital,
Brandenkrois.
Good luck, everyone!"
Touya: "All right, let's go!"
Growster: "Hehehehe, just you wait.
I'll put an end to you now..."
Ai: "...Are we sure it's safe to let that old man command?"
Touya: "...I'm worried."
Growster: "Come on, let's go! Set sail!"
Ai: "Sigh... I dread what's ahead..."
Cain: "...At this rate, I won't make it in time...
I've no choice... I'll have to hurry a little... Ugh!"
Cain: "Cough, cough... Gah!
!! Th-this is..."
Cain: "I'm grateful, Bernst."
Bernst: "You have indeed been reborn.
But it would be wise
not to overuse your 'power.'
Otherwise, you'll lose that hard-won life again.
I have no intention of volunteering
a second time."
Cain: "...N-not... I can't die yet...
Not like this... I... Rayfon, wait for me...
Soon I'll avenge your suffering... Hehehehehe..."
Tix: "...Huh? Why am I... here...?
Ahead is the Chamber of Sealing... The place that protects the 'Guardian'..."
Tix: "...What is this? It feels familiar...
But a little different somehow..."
Tix: "Is that... an Armored Mech...?
No, something else..."
Tix: "...Wh-who's there?!"
?????: "...Hello. It's been a while, Tix."
Tix: "N-no way... Rayfon... Brother?"
Celica: "Um, Clovis, Xiujian, Ai, Aurelie
and Kururu will take Liebhofen with General Growster's group
to Zigrim. And..."
Celica: "Arthur, Fain, Kasumi, Melissa
and I will go with Major Rest
to the royal capital, Shangria."
Celica: "Arthur, Fain, Kasumi and I
will go with Major Rest
to the royal capital, Shangria."
Celica: "...Thank you.
Then you and Yamato, Touya,
will go straight to the capital with us.
Good luck, everyone!"
Touya: "All right, let's go!"
Rest: "There's no time. I'm sorry, everyone,
but please get ready right away."
Touya: "Yeah, got it."
Kasumi: "Let's do our best, Touya."
Touya: "Yeah."
Cain: "...At this rate, I won't make it in time...
I've no choice... I'll have to hurry a little... Ugh!"
Cain: "Cough, cough... Gah!
!! Th-this is..."
Cain: "I'm grateful, Bernst."
Bernst: "You have indeed been reborn.
But it would be wise
not to overuse your 'power.'
Otherwise, you'll lose that hard-won life again.
I have no intention of volunteering
a second time."
Cain: "...N-not... I can't die yet...
Not like this... I... Rayfon, wait for me...
Soon I'll avenge your suffering... Hehehehehe..."
Tix: "...Huh? Why am I... here...?
Ahead is the Chamber of Sealing... The place that protects the 'Guardian'..."
Tix: "...What is this? It feels familiar...
But a little different somehow..."
Tix: "Is that... an Armored Mech...?
No, something else..."
Tix: "...Wh-who's there?!"
?????: "...Hello. It's been a while, Tix."
Tix: "N-no way... Rayfon... Brother?"
Arthur: "Oh? Isn't General Growster with you?"
Rest: "No. We offered our help, but he turned us down.
Apparently, they're returning home now
to confront the president."
Ai: "What?! How did it come to that?!"
Celica: "...Rest, would you explain?"
Rest: "Of course. Actually..."
Arthur: "...So Zigrim's President Horem secretly restarted
the project called 'Code 3,'
and used it in the last battle and the coup
in Agarthia?"
Rest: "Yes. With a drug that robs people of their will
and amplifies only their fighting instinct.
Prince Cain is continuing further experiments
in the capital, and they're proceeding in Zigrim too."
Celica: "...And so Marshal Growster
decided to confront him,
even if he was branded a traitor..."
Rest: "Yes. If that project is fully put into practice,
war will turn into mere slaughter.
Even the guilt soldiers ought to bear will be gone.
War stripped of humanity is... a tragedy."
Ai: "I don't think war with humanity is good either,
but you're right, we don't have time for that argument now.
If things like that last battle happen everywhere,
we'll destroy ourselves before ≪Ze=Ode≫
even does anything..."
Aurelie: "So, what do we do?
If Zigrim turned down our help, are we going back to the capital?
Cain's there too..."
Clovis: "That might be the right choice."
Celica: "So there was something like that behind the coup after all..."
Xiujian: "...Even if they control the key people,
that alone would make it no more than a riot.
Wouldn't it just encourage neighboring countries to intervene?"
Rest: "...The coup forces claim to be
rebuilding that corrupt country. And... Prince Lodis
has no legitimate right to the throne, they say.
They put forward Prince Tix as the rightful heir
who will rebuild the kingdom."
Arthur: "Straight out of the textbook.
But does His Highness really have no right to succeed?"
Rest: "Impossible."
Sisk: "Exactly! It's obviously a fabrication!"
Celica: "...That much is true."
Sisk: "...Huh?"
Celica: "Yes, we were both born to Mother.
But before she married Father,
she was already carrying my brother.
Because Mother was a 'child of power'..."
Touya: "A 'child of power'?"
Celica: "Someone born with high Prana
and the gift of hearing the Guardian's voice.
I don't know why, but they're born only to the royal bloodline.
Tradition says that if someone with that power takes the throne,
the kingdom will prosper. And in fact, it has."
Celica: "Mother was a distant relative of the royal family, but she'd been raised freely.
She had fallen in love with a knight serving her at the time.
But for the sake of the country, the senior ministers of that time
forced her to marry Father,
who was then the crown prince... But Father knew everything, and still
he loved Mother... As she lay dying,
she told my brother and me that she'd been happy,
and smiled. So even after I learned the truth,
I was happy for things to stay as they were.
My brother was still my brother."
Touya: "I see..."
Clovis: "Then what they're claiming
is true..."
Ai: "But if force is the only way they can claim to be right,
that shows how little they amount to."
Touya: "Then shall we head for the capital now?"
Rest: "...We can't simply do that.
We've discovered the existence
of 'Code 3's' central facility."
Ai: "What?!"
Celica: "...Where?"
Rest: "The Great Deilworth Forest spreads south
of Brandenkrois, Zigrim's capital.
The facility appears to be a little south of that."
Celica: "Deilworth... Isn't that..."
Rest: "Yes. Officially, the facility exists
to develop safe, high-quality food."
Celica: "I see. That facility was the first national project
President Horem undertook after taking office, wasn't it?
It was all over the news."
Rest: "Yes. First, they force it
into the public's attention and memory. Then, once it's forgotten,
they switch to the real purpose...
Few people willingly pay attention to something they've lost interest in.
All the more so if it's now something commonplace
and unremarkable."
Arthur: "Is that information reliable?"
Rest: "The informant is First Lieutenant Reamond Dalaim
of the Zigrim Republican Army..."
Yamato: "Reamond? The one who was in that last battle...?"
Celica: "It's dangerous to trust him unconditionally just because
he's a Zigrim officer. His information itself
could be wrong..."
Miyasco: "...I think it's probably correct."
Celica: "Huh...?"
Miyasco: "Oh, I-I'm sorry.
But, um..."
Touya: "...I think that information is worth trusting too.
You have proper grounds for it, right?"
Rest: "Yes."
Touya: "Then why not take that chance?
There's no certain road to the future. If there is,
it's only a coward's escape route."
Celica: "...A coward...
Perhaps that is a way of thinking that runs away.
...But you're sure this will be all right?"
Rest: "Yes. I already knew
something about 'Code 3.' Compared with that,
there's no contradiction. In fact, I judged it highly probable."
Xiujian: "...Then there are two paths before us.
Go to the facility and cut off the project's chance of continuing.
Or go to the capital
and stop Prince Cain's plot."
Arthur: "It means dividing our forces,
but we have no time to spare. We'll have to act
simultaneously."
Celica: "...You're right. Given the distances,
that means Liebhofen goes to Zigrim..."
Clovis: "I'll leave the assignments to Celica.
I'm sure no one objects.
You're all right with that too, aren't you?"
Rest: "Of course. Princess, we leave it to you."
